notes: Libretto by Emanuel Schikaneder (1791). Words as printed in the Edition Peters vocal score, which the app follows where it differs from the libretto: "erlässt", "Verläumdung", "bestände", "selber", "darinnen" and "wie man die Burg" as the print has them, the old spellings "thun", "werth", "Tigerthier", "vonnöthen", "grössten" and "Sarastro's", the apostrophes in "Lieb'", "ohn'", "trau'", "empfehl'", "bedank'", "Werd'", "geh'n" and "Wiederseh'n", and the repeats of the music. Papageno's "Hm!" is hummed with the mouth closed: the padlock is still on. In bar 66 Papageno rests while the others sing "bestände Lieb'" and comes in on "und Bruderbund". All five sing "eurem" in "sind zu eurem Schutz vonnöthen". IPA follows sung German stage diction: final -er, -ern as [ɐ]; the prefixes er-, ver-, zer- with [ɛr]; r elsewhere rolled or flipped; ch as [ç] after front vowels and [x] after back vowels; glottal stops [ʔ] before initial vowels; final b d g devoiced.
